evidenceClasses.label: Official
evidenceClasses.description: Manufacturer specification or announcement. Describes what the product is claimed to be, not how well it performs.

evidenceClasses.label: Measured
evidenceClasses.description: Independent test with a documented, repeatable method, run by a reviewer or lab on a real unit.

evidenceClasses.label: Database
evidenceClasses.description: Aggregated benchmark database or compiled result set (for example medians of many user runs, or scores collected by a publication).

evidenceClasses.label: Reviewer
evidenceClasses.description: Qualitative observation from a reviewer. Useful context, but not a measurement.

evidenceClasses.label: News
evidenceClasses.description: Reported by a news outlet: launches, prices, software updates, issues, recalls.

evidenceClasses.label: Community
evidenceClasses.description: User reports or crowd-sourced data. Lower weight because samples may be unrepresentative.

evidenceClasses.label: Estimated
evidenceClasses.description: Estimate, leak, pre-release or prototype result, or a value inferred from a pattern rather than a commitment.

evidenceClasses.label: Platform analysis
evidenceClasses.description: Calculated by this platform from other evidence: consensus values, unit conversions, scores and verdicts. Never a new measurement.

sourceTiers.label: Official
sourceTiers.description: The manufacturer. Authoritative for what a product is; not independent evidence of how it performs.

sourceTiers.label: Tier A
sourceTiers.description: Established lab, database or reviewer with a published, repeatable test method.

sourceTiers.label: Tier B
sourceTiers.description: Reputable outlet with a limited or undocumented method, or one that mainly reports other people's results.

sourceTiers.label: Tier C
sourceTiers.description: Unverified, anonymous or community source. Shown for context only.

confidenceLevels.label: High
confidenceLevels.description: Multiple independent reliable sources agree, or the value is an official specification.

confidenceLevels.label: Medium
confidenceLevels.description: Limited independent testing: one strong source, sources that partly disagree, or a chipset result used as a stand-in for the device.

confidenceLevels.label: Low
confidenceLevels.description: Mainly leaks, pre-release units, a single secondary source, or sources that disagree strongly.
